name: 执行层-技术状态与跟进明细
description: 技术状态变更钻取页面，展示变更清单、状态分布及跟进措施。

components.name: 执行层-技术状态与跟进明细

config.text: 执行层-技术状态与跟进明细

sqlConfig.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(order_signed_cnt)::numeric/(SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "签署完成率", CASE WHEN (SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)::numeric/(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "整改完成率", CASE WHEN SUM(total_change_cnt)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric/SUM(total_change_cnt)::numeric*100,2) END AS "未签署比率" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(order_signed_cnt)::numeric/(SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "签署完成率", CASE WHEN (SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)::numeric/(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "整改完成率", CASE WHEN SUM(total_change_cnt)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric/SUM(total_change_cnt)::numeric*100,2) END AS "未签署比率" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(order_signed_cnt)::numeric/(SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "签署完成率", CASE WHEN (SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)::numeric/(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "整改完成率", CASE WHEN SUM(total_change_cnt)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric/SUM(total_change_cnt)::numeric*100,2) END AS "未签署比率" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

WITH agg AS (SELECT SUM(order_signed_cnt) AS order_signed_cnt, SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii) AS order_unsigned_total, SUM(reform_done_i_ii) AS reform_done_i_ii, SUM(reform_pending_i_ii) AS reform_pending_i_ii, SUM(total_change_cnt) AS total_change_cnt FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]) SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN (order_signed_cnt+order_unsigned_total)=0 THEN 0 ELSE order_signed_cnt::numeric/(order_signed_cnt+order_unsigned_total)::numeric*100 END)*0.4 + (CASE WHEN (reform_done_i_ii+reform_pending_i_ii)=0 THEN 0 ELSE reform_done_i_ii::numeric/(reform_done_i_ii+reform_pending_i_ii)::numeric*100 END)*0.4 + (100 - CASE WHEN total_change_cnt=0 THEN 0 ELSE order_unsigned_total::numeric/total_change_cnt::numeric*100 END)*0.2, 2) AS "技术健康度" FROM agg

SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", tech_state_name AS "技术状态名称", change_item AS "更改项目", owner AS "负责人", dept AS "责任科室", change_category AS "更改类别", file_signature_status AS "文件签署状态", reform_status AS "整改状态", CASE WHEN is_signature_completed THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS "签署完成", change_submit_time AS "提交时间", signature_closure_date AS "签署闭环日期" FROM biz_dwd_tech_state_v2 WHERE submit_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND submit_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]] ORDER BY change_submit_time DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT SUM(total_change_cnt) AS "变更总数", SUM(new_cat_i) AS "I类", SUM(new_cat_ii) AS "II类", SUM(new_cat_iii) AS "III类", SUM(order_signed_cnt) AS "已签署", SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii) AS "未签署", SUM(reform_done_i_ii) AS "已整改", SUM(reform_pending_i_ii) AS "待整改" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", tech_state_name AS "技术状态名称", change_item AS "更改项目", owner AS "负责人", dept AS "责任科室", change_category AS "更改类别", file_signature_status AS "文件签署状态", reform_status AS "整改状态", CASE WHEN is_signature_completed THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS "签署完成", change_submit_time AS "提交时间", signature_closure_date AS "签署闭环日期" FROM biz_dwd_tech_state_v2 WHERE submit_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND submit_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]] ORDER BY change_submit_time DESC NULLS LAST
